title: Plants near pets
description: Open verifiable information for a confirmed species and a specific animal, keeping the gaps in the information visible.

blocks.text: A person wants to find out about one particular plant near their pet. On the card, the confirmed name, the animal chosen and the basis of the information have to be distinguishable; a general “safe” label hides too many conditions.

quote.text: I could not determine, from the app, if the identified plant is considered toxic to humans or animals.

blocks.text: You can start with a limited checked reference book. The search and the saved card show consistent wording, while recognition that has not been confirmed, or missing information, stays explicitly marked.
Do not turn the unknown into permission

This is a content product that needs constant editorial checking, not an extra badge next to the photograph. The reviews available cannot establish whether particular claims about toxicity are correct; here they show a demand for clear and consistent information.
